name: Abyssal Tiefling

traits.name: Abyssal Resistance
traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Poison Spray
traits.description: At character level 1, know Poison Spray and cast it at will.

traits.name: Ray Of Sickness
traits.description: At character level 3, always have Ray Of Sickness available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.

traits.name: Hold Person
traits.description: At character level 5, always have Hold Person available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.

reviewNotes: Inherits Fiend (Native), normal biological needs, Low-Light Vision and Thaumaturgy from species.tiefling.
Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma when selecting this ancestry. The choice governs all granted Tiefling spells, including Thaumaturgy.
Level 3 and level 5 spells have independent once-per-Long-Rest free castings; appropriate spell slots can be used additionally.
No mandatory cultural Upbringing or language; relative benefit and spell balance remain subject to playtesting.
